title: Cushing's Point Museum

services.name: Fishermen's Point Fishing Shacks
services.desc: In 2022, our friends at SMRT Architects & Engineers in Portland volunteered their time and expertise to help document the last remaining fishing shacks at Fishermen's Point. The initial goal of the project was to create a set of architectural drawings which could be used by our community to rebuild either or both of the fishing shacks, should they be lost in a storm. Those drawings are now complete and housed at the South Portland Historical Society. SMRT took the project a step further by also photographing all aspects of the fishing shacks inside and creating a 3D image that allows the viewer to explore the interior of each shack.
